display_duration.description: Seconds on screen when playing without a banner

live_priority.description: Take over the display whenever something is playing

entities.description: media_player entity ids in priority order (Shield, music players, native Plex entity ...)

entity_services.description: Players that report no app_name: {"media_player.x": "spotify"}. Keys: plex, netflix, youtube, youtube_tv, youtube_music, disney, spotify, hulu, prime, max

tmdb_services.description: Services whose titles are looked up on TMDB for banners. Keep this to plex.

tmdb_token.description: TMDB API Read Access Token (starts with eyJ), NOT the v3 key

plex_url.description: Plex server URL, for the idle recently-added rotation

banner_seconds.description: Seconds of banner per cycle while playing

info_seconds.description: Seconds of info card per cycle. 0 = banner only

paused_timeout.description: Stop showing a paused player after this many seconds

show_service_badge.description: Small service icon next to the time when art replaces the big icon

banner_progress.description: 2px progress line along the bottom of the banner

portal_enabled.description: Serve the web portal (live view, banner picker, icons and GIFs)

portal_port.description: Portal port. 5010 so it can run beside plex-marquee (5009) and now-playing (5008); use 5009 once plex-marquee is disabled

max_upload_mb.description: Largest icon/GIF upload accepted by the portal

now_playing_burst.title: NOW PLAYING Burst
now_playing_burst.description: Show a short sunburst with the title when something new starts playing.

title_font.title: Title Font
title_font.description: Font for the title on the info card. 7x13B is bold; 6x10 fits more text; MatrixChunky8 is compact; 3x5 is the blocky arcade font.
